contributor_charter.title: DISCREETKIT CONTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT
body: 1. THE GOAL
We are building DiscreetKit to solve a simple problem: People need health products (like HIV tests and contraceptives) but are too shy to buy them in person. We make it private, safe, and easy.
2. YOUR ROLE
You are joining us as a Voluntary Contributor. We are a startup at Day One. We don't have salaries yet, but we have a massive opportunity.
The Deal (What You Get):
• Credit: You can put every piece of work you do here in your portfolio.
• Future Hiring: When we raise money, we hire our Contributors first.
• References: The Founders will give you strong recommendations for your career.
• Commissions: Sales/Growth roles get paid commissions on the sales they bring in.
3. THE ONE BIG RULE: PRIVACY
We sell privacy. Never share customer data. If you see a name, location, or order, keep it 100% secret. Leaking data destroys our business and gets us sued.
4. WHO OWNS THE WORK?
To raise money from investors, the company needs to own the code and designs. By signing this, you agree that the work you create for DiscreetKit belongs to Access Discreetkit Ltd.
5. FREEDOM
You can leave anytime. Just give us a heads-up so we can cover your tasks.
6. AGREEMENT
I’m in. I understand this is a volunteer role for now. I promise to keep company secrets safe.

partnership_proposal.title: PARTNERSHIP PROPOSAL: INCREASE YOUR SALES
body: We want to help you sell more products to customers who are currently too shy to walk into your shop.
The Missed Opportunity: Thousands of young people in Ghana need reproductive health products but fear judgment. They are hiding, and that means lost sales for you.
The Solution: DiscreetKit. We are an online ordering platform. Customers order privately on their phones, and we send the orders to you.
How We Work Together:
1. We Bring the Customers: We handle the marketing and the online order.
2. You Pack the Order: We send the order details to your pharmacy.
3. We Handle Delivery: Our rider picks it up and delivers it anonymously.
Why Partner?
• More Revenue: You get sales you wouldn't get otherwise.
• No Cost: We don't charge you to join.
• Zero Hassle: You just sell the product. We do the logistics.
Let's discuss how we can start sending orders to you.

investor_brief.title: INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY: DISCREETKIT
body: The Problem:

There is a huge market of young people in Ghana who need health products (HIV tests, contraceptives) but are terrified of the 'pharmacy stare.' They want to buy, but they don't want to be seen. This is millions in lost revenue.
The Solution:
DiscreetKit. We are the 'Uber for Privacy.' We let customers order sensitive products anonymously and get them delivered in plain, unbranded packages.
Why We Make Money:
• No Inventory Cost: We don't buy stock. We partner with pharmacies and use their inventory.
• High Trust = High Retention: Once a user trusts us with their privacy, they stick with us.
• Ready to Scale: We are a registered company (Access Discreetkit Ltd) with a working product and a dedicated team.
The Ask:
We are raising [Investment Amount] to launch aggressively on university campuses in Accra. This money covers marketing and setting up our delivery network.
We have the tech. We have the team. We just need the fuel to grow.

nda.title: NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (NDA)
body: This agreement is between {{COMPANY_NAME}} and [Recipient Company] to protect confidential information.
1. What is Confidential? Any business plans, customer lists, financial data, or trade secrets shared by {{COMPANY_NAME}}.
2. Your Duty: You agree to keep this information secret. You cannot share it with anyone else or use it for your own benefit.
3. Duration: This agreement lasts for 3 years.
4. Return of Data: If we stop working together, you must return or delete our data immediately.
By signing below, you agree to these terms.
